name: DataFlint

windows_docker_install: driver plugin: spark.jars.packages io.dataflint:spark_2.12:0.9.9 + spark.plugins=io.dataflint.spark.SparkDataflintPlugin; for Spark 4: dataflint-spark4_2.13; needs Maven Central access at runtime (or vendor the jar)
